symptoms: Scattered yellowing leaves with isolated dead heart shoots that pull out easily; minimal egg mass activity.
Reaches ETL; noticeable dead hearts across tillers and initial white earhead formation; larvae boring inside stem base.
Widespread tiller death and prominent erect white panicles devoid of grain; substantial yield reduction underway.
Catastrophic crop collapse; majority of tillers severed internally; complete panicle sterility across field.

severe.symptom_description: Widespread tiller death and prominent erect white panicles devoid of grain; substantial yield reduction underway.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Catastrophic crop collapse; majority of tillers severed internally; complete panicle sterility across field.

symptoms: Initial nymph colonization at base of tillers; slight yellowing of lowest older leaves; no lodging.
Reaches ETL; noticeable yellowing extending up tiller canopy; visible honeydew excretion and sooty mold at tiller base.
Severe sap depletion; localized circular drying patches (early hopper burn); tillers wilting and becoming brittle.
Widespread contiguous hopper burn patches spreading across field; crop collapse and complete plant drying.

early.symptom_description: Initial nymph colonization at base of tillers; slight yellowing of lowest older leaves; no lodging.

moderate.symptom_description: Reaches ETL; noticeable yellowing extending up tiller canopy; visible honeydew excretion and sooty mold at tiller base.

severe.symptom_description: Severe sap depletion; localized circular drying patches (early hopper burn); tillers wilting and becoming brittle.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Widespread contiguous hopper burn patches spreading across field; crop collapse and complete plant drying.

recommendation: Standard Evaluation System (SES) 1-9 rating for Brown planthopper (BPH).

symptoms: Isolated folded leaves with fine white scraped longitudinal streaks; plant growth largely unaffected.
Reaches ETL; multiple folded leaves per hill; larvae actively scraping chlorophyll from inside rolls.
Severe leaf rolling across canopy; significant photosynthesis reduction; white papery appearance on upper third of crop.
Whitish scorched field appearance across entire parcel; extensive flag leaf destruction leading to grain unfilled chaffiness.

early.symptom_description: Isolated folded leaves with fine white scraped longitudinal streaks; plant growth largely unaffected.

moderate.cutoff_range: 6%-15% folded leaves (or 5%-10% damaged flag leaves at booting)

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Whitish scorched field appearance across entire parcel; extensive flag leaf destruction leading to grain unfilled chaffiness.

recommendation: Standard Evaluation System (SES) 1-9 rating for Leaf folder.

symptoms: Low adult activity; slight tip yellowing; no virus transmission symptoms detected.
Reaches ETL; active hopper jumping in canopy; margin chlorosis developing on middle leaves.
Heavy sap drainage; widespread yellow-orange leaf discoloration; stunted tiller vigor.
Complete leaf chlorosis or virulent Rice Tungro Virus spreading with pronounced stunting and sterile panicles.

severe.symptom_description: Heavy sap drainage; widespread yellow-orange leaf discoloration; stunted tiller vigor.

severe_spreading.cutoff_range: >30 hoppers/hill or active Tungro epidemic spreading
severe_spreading.symptom_description: Complete leaf chlorosis or virulent Rice Tungro Virus spreading with pronounced stunting and sterile panicles.

symptoms: Occasional silver shoots (onion galls) visible at tiller base; plant compensation still possible.
Reaches ETL; prominent silver shoots causing sterile tiller loss in 5-10% of shoots.
Extensive tiller galling; high percentage of shoots unable to develop productive earheads.
Massive tiller destruction across field; stunted bushy appearance of hills with severe yield collapse.

moderate.symptom_description: Reaches ETL; prominent silver shoots causing sterile tiller loss in 5-10% of shoots.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Massive tiller destruction across field; stunted bushy appearance of hills with severe yield collapse.

symptoms: Minute silvery spots on upper leaf surfaces; mild inward rolling of leaf tips.
Reaches ETL; conspicuous needle-like leaf rolling; tips drying and yellowing.
Extensive leaf curling and drying across seedling bed; scorched appearance of nursery.
Death of nursery seedlings under moisture stress; complete loss of transplantable nursery stand.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Death of nursery seedlings under moisture stress; complete loss of transplantable nursery stand.

recommendation: Standard Evaluation System (SES) 1-9 rating for Thrips.

symptoms: Small yellowish feeding streaks on newly expanded central leaves; seedling vigor unaffected.
Reaches ETL; ragged serrated leaf margins visible on multiple expanding leaves per hill.
Conspicuous broken serrated leaf blades and distorted central whorls across the plot.
Severe plant stunting, delayed tillering, and general stand vigor reduction in flooded fields.

Reaches ETL; milky grains being pierced; foul odor noticeable upon entering field; brown spots on maturing grains.
Numerous damaged, shriveled, partially filled grains with blackened feeding punctures; strong pungent odor.
Massive grain loss; over 30% empty/chaffy erect panicles; severe economic devaluation of grain lot.

symptoms: Water-soaked translucent stripes along leaf margins; yellow-orange wavy margins on isolated upper leaves.
Lesions expanding along leaf blade with characteristic wavy margins and milky bacterial ooze beads on damp mornings.
Lesions coalescing; blighting of upper leaves including flag leaf; early kresek (systemic wilting) on susceptible varieties.
Complete leaf drying, systemic kresek wilting of entire hills, premature crop lodging and severe unfilled grains.

severe_spreading.cutoff_range: >25%-50% leaf area affected or severe kresek phase
severe_spreading.symptom_description: Complete leaf drying, systemic kresek wilting of entire hills, premature crop lodging and severe unfilled grains.

symptoms: Small brown specks or circular to spindle-shaped lesions (1-2 mm) with grey center on lower canopy leaves.
Typical spindle-shaped lesions (0.5-1.5 cm) with grey/whitish centers and dark reddish-brown borders on middle leaves.
Lesions coalescing causing leaf necrosis; blackish-brown lesion developing at panicle node/neck (early neck blast).
Complete leaf canopy burning; neck blast causing snapping of panicle base and complete chaffiness of earhead.

early.cutoff_range: <1%-5% leaf area with pinhead/small spindle lesions
early.symptom_description: Small brown specks or circular to spindle-shaped lesions (1-2 mm) with grey center on lower canopy leaves.

moderate.cutoff_range: 6%-10% leaf area with typical spindle-shaped lesions
moderate.symptom_description: Typical spindle-shaped lesions (0.5-1.5 cm) with grey/whitish centers and dark reddish-brown borders on middle leaves.

severe.cutoff_range: 11%-25% leaf area affected or initial neck blast
severe.symptom_description: Lesions coalescing causing leaf necrosis; blackish-brown lesion developing at panicle node/neck (early neck blast).

severe_spreading.cutoff_range: >25% leaf area affected or >10% rotten neck blast
severe_spreading.symptom_description: Complete leaf canopy burning; neck blast causing snapping of panicle base and complete chaffiness of earhead.

symptoms: Oval or greenish-grey water-soaked lesions on leaf sheaths just above the water level.
Lesions enlarging with irregular brownish borders and grey-white centers; spreading upward along tillers.
Lesions coalescing and reaching the flag leaf sheath and collar; white sclerotia visible on lesions.
Infection covering entire plant height including panicle; tillers rotting at base leading to severe lodging.

early.cutoff_range: RLH <= 20% (lesions restricted to lower sheaths near waterline)

severe_spreading.cutoff_range: RLH > 60% (lesions spreading into flag leaf blade and panicle)
severe_spreading.symptom_description: Infection covering entire plant height including panicle; tillers rotting at base leading to severe lodging.

symptoms: Slight stunting; light yellow or pale green discoloration on youngest emerging leaves of isolated hills.
Marked stunting; vivid yellow to orange-yellow leaf discoloration starting from tips; reduced tillering.
Severe plant stunting, rusty orange discoloration, delayed flowering, and partial emergence of sterile panicles.
Field-wide epidemic; severe stunting with entire crop turning orange-yellow; total grain yield loss.

early.symptom_description: Slight stunting; light yellow or pale green discoloration on youngest emerging leaves of isolated hills.

moderate.symptom_description: Marked stunting; vivid yellow to orange-yellow leaf discoloration starting from tips; reduced tillering.

severe.symptom_description: Severe plant stunting, rusty orange discoloration, delayed flowering, and partial emergence of sterile panicles.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Field-wide epidemic; severe stunting with entire crop turning orange-yellow; total grain yield loss.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC for Stem borer, Leaf folder. Dosage: 150 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 47 days. Toxicity: Green Label (Low mammalian toxicity). Notes: CIBRC registered for Rice Stem Borer and Leaf Folder. Safe to natural enemies.
safety_constraints: Green Label (Low mammalian toxicity)
CIBRC registered for Rice Stem Borer and Leaf Folder. Safe to natural enemies.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Buprofezin 25 SC for Brown planthopper (BPH), Green leafhopper (GLH). Dosage: 400-800 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Insect Growth Regulator). Notes: CIBRC approved for rice hoppers. Direct spray to base of tillers.
safety_constraints: Blue Label (Insect Growth Regulator)
CIBRC approved for rice hoppers. Direct spray to base of tillers.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL for Green leafhopper (GLH), Brown planthopper (BPH). Dosage: 100-125 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 21 days. Toxicity: Yellow Label (Neonicotinoid). Notes: Approved for rice hoppers; suppresses GLH vector to prevent Tungro virus transmission.
safety_constraints: Yellow Label (Neonicotinoid)
Approved for rice hoppers; suppresses GLH vector to prevent Tungro virus transmission.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Thiamethoxam 25 WG for Thrips, Stem borer, GLH. Dosage: 100 g/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 14 days. Toxicity: Green Label (Neonicotinoid). Notes: Approved for rice thrips and stem borer. Suitable for nursery and tillering.
safety_constraints: Green Label (Neonicotinoid)
Approved for rice thrips and stem borer. Suitable for nursery and tillering.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Carbofuran 3G for Stem borer, Gall midge, Whorl maggot. Dosage: 33 kg/ha at planting. Regulatory Status: RESTRICTED (Restricted / Phased Ban). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 60 days. Toxicity: Red Label (Class Ib High Toxicity). Notes: Carbamate with high avian and groundwater toxicity. Restricted/banned across several states. Requires warning.
safety_constraints: Red Label (Class Ib High Toxicity)
Carbamate with high avian and groundwater toxicity. Restricted/banned across several states. Requires warning.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Malathion 50 EC for Earhead bug. Dosage: 500-1000 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: RESTRICTED (Approved with Strict PHI). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 10 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Organophosphate). Notes: Applied during grain milking; high grain residue risk. Mandatory minimum 7-10 days PHI.
safety_constraints: Blue Label (Organophosphate)
Applied during grain milking; high grain residue risk. Mandatory minimum 7-10 days PHI.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Copper hydroxide 77 WP for Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB), False Smut, Bacterial Leaf Streak (BLS). Dosage: 1.25 kg/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 15 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Inorganic Copper). Notes: Approved for bacterial blight and false smut. Apply preventively at boot leaf.
safety_constraints: Blue Label (Inorganic Copper)
Approved for bacterial blight and false smut. Apply preventively at boot leaf.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Tricyclazole 75 WP for Rice Blast (Leaf & Neck). Dosage: 500 g/ha (0.6 g/L water). Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Triazole). Notes: Gold standard blasticide; highly systemic; prevents appressorial melanization.
safety_constraints: Blue Label (Triazole)
Gold standard blasticide; highly systemic; prevents appressorial melanization.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Isoprothiolane 40 EC for Rice Blast. Dosage: 750 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Dithiolane). Notes: Approved for rice blast; inhibits phospholipid biosynthesis.
safety_constraints: Blue Label (Dithiolane)
Approved for rice blast; inhibits phospholipid biosynthesis.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Hexaconazole 5 SC / 5 EC for Sheath Blight. Dosage: 1000 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Green Label (Triazole). Notes: Systemic triazole fungicide targeting ergosterol biosynthesis.
safety_constraints: Green Label (Triazole)
Systemic triazole fungicide targeting ergosterol biosynthesis.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Validamycin 3 L for Sheath Blight. Dosage: 1000 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 14 days. Toxicity: Green Label (Antibiotic/Fungicide). Notes: Antibiotic fungicide derived from Streptomyces hygroscopicus; inhibits trehalase.
safety_constraints: Green Label (Antibiotic/Fungicide)
Antibiotic fungicide derived from Streptomyces hygroscopicus; inhibits trehalase.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole 18.2% + 11.4% SC (29.6 SC) for Sheath Blight, Rice Blast. Dosage: 500 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 31 days. Toxicity: Blue Label (Strobilurin + Triazole). Notes: Broad-spectrum combination with dual translaminar and systemic modes of action.
safety_constraints: Blue Label (Strobilurin + Triazole)
Broad-spectrum combination with dual translaminar and systemic modes of action.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Propiconazole 25 EC for Sheath Rot, False Smut. Dosage: 500 ml/ha in 500 L water. Regulatory Status: VERIFIED_CURRENT (Approved). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Yellow Label (Triazole). Notes: Approved for sheath rot and false smut. Must be applied at booting stage for false smut.
safety_constraints: Yellow Label (Triazole)
Approved for sheath rot and false smut. Must be applied at booting stage for false smut.

recommendation: Chemical Prescription: Streptocycline + Copper Oxychloride 90:10 SP + 50 WP for Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB). Dosage: 100 g + 500 g per hectare. Regulatory Status: RESTRICTED (Restricted / Under Review). Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 30 days. Toxicity: Red/Yellow Label (Agricultural Antibiotic). Notes: Streptocycline is an antibiotic subject to Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) regulatory restrictions in Indian agriculture. Non-antibiotic alternatives (Copper Hydroxide) preferred.
safety_constraints: Red/Yellow Label (Agricultural Antibiotic)
Streptocycline is an antibiotic subject to Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) regulatory restrictions in Indian agriculture. Non-antibiotic alternatives (Copper Hydroxide) preferred.
